text: Preparing two manuscripts on graph neural networks for Alzheimer's disease: a review for IEEE Reviews in Biomedical Engineering and a resolution-aware source-space EEG study for Computers in Biology and Medicine.
Published "Band-specific EEG connectivity and graph-theoretical features for attention detection" in Neuroelectronics.
TODO: Defended MSc thesis on Riemannian manifold representations of functional connectivity for EEG-based attention detection.
Started a research internship at NYU Abu Dhabi on Theory of Mind in large language models.
Presented GBrain, a graph signal processing approach to EEG-based attention detection, at IEEE ICABME 2025.
